mapper.select: SELECT script_sha256 FROM ad_billing_schema_history WHERE version=2
mapper.insert: WITH issued AS (SELECT clock_timestamp() AS instant) INSERT INTO ad_cpm_quote(traffic_class,quote_id,delivery_id,advertiser_id,ad_id,slot,currency,price_unit,pricing_version, amount,threshold,bill_factor,increment_amount,floor_amount,cap_amount,payload_hash,issued_at,expires_at) SELECT 'SANDBOX',#{quoteId},#{deliveryId},#{advertiserId},#{adId},#{slot},'CNY','PER_IMPRESSION','CPM_GSP_CNY6_V1', #{amount},#{threshold},#{billFactor},#{increment},#{floor},#{cap},#{payloadHash},instant,instant+interval '5 minutes' FROM issued WHERE instant < #{deadline} ON CONFLICT DO NOTHING
mapper.select: SELECT payload_hash FROM ad_cpm_quote WHERE traffic_class='SANDBOX' AND quote_id=#{quoteId}
